cells.label: fact

items.text: Raymond James positions itself through AdvisorChoice®, a platform of multiple affiliation options (traditional employee, Advisor Select, independent contractor, bank & credit union, corporate RIA, RIA & custody services), each offering a unique combination of support, freedom and flexibility backed by a leading independent firm.
items.quote: Through AdvisorChoice®, you have the ability to match your professional goals to the affiliation option that's right for you, each offering a unique combination of support, freedom and flexibility – and all backed by the full support of a leading independent financial firm.

items.text: The firm describes its value proposition as a 'best-of-both-worlds' combination of an advisor and client-focused culture coupled with leading technology and solutions, with a strong balance sheet and commitment to independence as a differentiator.
items.quote: Our best-of-both-worlds value proposition, where we offer a unique combination of an advisor and client-focused culture coupled with leading technology and solutions, continues to resonate with advisors across all of our affiliation options. Additionally, our strong balance sheet and commitment to independence is proving to be a differentiator for advisors evaluating alternatives.

items.text: Raymond James says it has the largest addressable market across its affiliation options (employee to independent contractor to RIA custody) with critical mass and decades of experience in all of them, and that this value proposition, cultural fit and platform appeal to advisors from many different firms, not just one.
items.quote: we have the largest addressable market across our affiliation options, from employee to independent contractor to the RIA custody, and we have critical mass and decades of experience in all of them... that value proposition, the cultural fit, the platform that I talked about, the multiple affiliation options, it's appealing to advisors from a lot of different firms.

items.text: The firm states it does not lead with the highest check but with culture and capabilities, offering a differentiated value proposition rather than competing primarily on economics/transition assistance.
items.quote: we don't lead with the highest check. We want to have competitive economics. Certainly, we have to have competitive economics, but we lead with culture and capabilities. And so we have a true differentiated value proposition.

items.text: Raymond James attributes its ability to attract high-quality advisors to its values-based culture, commitment to service, and the unique ways it provides services to financial advisors.
items.quote: Our ability to attract high quality advisors is based on our values-based culture, our commitment to service, and the unique ways in which we provide services to our financial advisors.

items.text: The firm frames its positioning as advisors not having to choose between culture and capabilities: a unique combination of an advisor- and client-focused culture along with leading technology, products and solutions needed to serve clients at a high level.
items.quote: advisers do not have to choose between culture and capabilities. We offer a unique combination of an adviser and client-focused culture along with the leading technology, products and solutions advisers need to serve clients at a high level.

cells.reason: Multiple passages directly describe how Raymond James positions itself to recruit advisors, including its affiliation options, culture-and-capabilities value proposition, and differentiation from wirehouse-style competition.
